lines.trans: All this time while filming, were you thinking anything goes because a mosaic blur covers it?
Human beings, deep down, all want to see what's hidden underneath.
Putting unadorned erotica into circulation for the world was my mission all along.

words.gram: Past tense of plain copula だ.

lines.trans: I got so busy I forgot! That's right—my true essence is uncensored video!
From now on let's shoot uncensored—no mosaic! That's how you become real actresses!
We're rolling live! Bring the gear and set up—I'll be the partner myself!

words.gram: Noun referring to one's counterpart or customer.

lines.trans: This man is completely finished...
What is she talking about? I am only getting started!
Go to hell!
In the end, once confronted with the real thing, everyone who isn't a pro runs away!
I only work with professionals! Everyone who isn't a pro, get out!
What are you standing around for? You're an eyesore—get out now!

meanings.note: Can stand at the head of a sentence without a particle ('right now').

meanings.en: nothing more than (after past verb); up to
meanings.note: After a plain verb + です (出店したまでです), modestly states 'we simply did that and nothing more'.

examples.text: 念のため聞いたまでです。
examples.trans: I merely asked just in case.

meanings.note: All-purpose action verb; turns Sino-Japanese nouns into verbs (融通する, 出店する) and with に means 'decide on' or 'make into'.

meanings.en: anyway; after all; in any case
meanings.note: Adverb expressing resignation, skepticism, or a foregone conclusion.

examples.text: どうせ今日も遅くなるよ。
examples.trans: I'll end up being late today anyway.

examples.text: どうせ誰も信じてくれない。

meanings.note: Marks the subject of existence, emergence, or questions (どれが), and at the end of a polite clause softens a request (のですが).

examples.text: お願いがあるのですが。
examples.trans: I have a favor to ask.

meanings.note: Godan verb: potential polite 入れます (はいれます) means 'can enter'.

examples.text: 予約なしでも入れますか。
examples.trans: Can we get in without a reservation?

meanings.note: Follows a clause to give a reason or reassuring explanation.

examples.trans: Because it is close, I walk.

meanings.note: Irregular i-adjective whose past/conditional stems use よ- (よかったら).

examples.text: よかったら来てください。

meanings.en: to think; to feel; to believe
meanings.note: Often follows quotative と to express an opinion or belief.

examples.text: それはいいと思います。

meanings.note: Links a modifying noun to a following noun, or turns a clause into an explanatory statement (often contracted to ん in speech).
Turns a statement into a question, or softens a volitional/negative guess.
Refers to humans in general or human nature.

examples.text: 人間には表と裏がある。
examples.trans: Human beings have a public face and a hidden side.

examples.text: 人間っちゅうのはな、ホントはみんな裏が見たいんだよ。
examples.trans: Human beings, deep down, all want to see what's hidden underneath.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.en: as for; topic or contrast marker
meanings.note: Written は but pronounced wa when marking the topic or contrasting one item with another.
Opposite of 表 (public surface); 裏の世界 means 'the underworld / hidden world'.

examples.text: 裏の世界を見せてやろうか。
examples.trans: Shall I show you the hidden world?
Write on the back of the paper.

meanings.note: Ichidan verb: blunt imperative 見ろ ('look!') is rough command speech.

examples.text: お前ら、観光じゃないんだからしっかりしろよ。
examples.trans: Hey, this isn't sightseeing, so pull yourselves together.

examples.text: 彼女は来るんだろうな？
ちゃんとキャストはそろってるんだろうな？
examples.trans: You've got the whole cast properly lined up, right?

meanings.note: Tells the listener something new or adds warm reassurance at the end of a sentence.
Written を and pronounced o; marks what an action directly acts upon.

examples.text: しかたがないだろ。世の中興味ねえよ。
examples.trans: Nothing can be done. The public does not care.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.en: target, location of existence, or result marker
meanings.note: Marks destination, location where something exists or sits, or the chosen result before する and なる.
Used among friends and peers by men; switch to 私 or 僕 in formal settings.
Refers to a solemn task or purpose one is meant to fulfill.

examples.text: 重要な使命を果たしました。

meanings.note: Plain sentence-ending copula; contracts or shifts to だった in past, だろう/だろ for supposition, and で/じゃ in combinations.

examples.text: 忙しさにかまけて忘れてた。そうだ、俺の本質は裏ビデオだよ！
examples.trans: I got so busy I forgot! That's right—my true essence is uncensored video!

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.en: in that way; that is so
meanings.note: そうですか ('Is that so? / I see') calmly acknowledges news.

examples.text: そうですか、わかりました。

meanings.note: Everyday word for books and bound publications.

examples.trans: I buy a book at the bookstore.

meanings.en: from now on; in the future; now
meanings.note: Time expression referring to the immediate or upcoming future.

examples.text: これから家へ帰ります。

examples.trans: The real test starts from here.

meanings.note: Compound of 本 (true) + 物 (thing); opposite of 偽物.

examples.trans: It looks just like the real thing.

meanings.note: Expresses change of state, or in polite customer service (になります) states an arrangement or price total.

examples.trans: That comes to one thousand yen.

meanings.note: Blunt or rowdy second-person pronoun used with subordinates, rivals, or close crew.

examples.trans: I leave it to you guys.

meanings.note: Attaches to pronouns or people nouns (僕ら, 彼ら).

examples.text: 本番だ！お前ら機材持ってこい、用意しろ！俺が相手になってやるよ！
examples.trans: We're rolling live! Bring the gear and set up—I'll be the partner myself!

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Godan verb; 持ってくる means 'bring'.

meanings.en: come; go do something and return (after て-form)
meanings.note: Written in kana after a て-form (話してきます), expresses stepping away to do an action and coming back.

examples.text: ちょっと水を買ってきます。
examples.trans: I will go buy some water and be right back.

meanings.note: Noun referring to whoever one is interacting with.

examples.text: 相手の話をよく聞きましょう。
examples.trans: Let's listen carefully to the other person.

meanings.en: do for an inferior (tough-guy てやる)
meanings.note: After て-form (勘弁してやる), expresses granting a favor from a position of authority.

examples.trans: I will give you a hand (casual masculine).

meanings.note: Directly modifies a noun near the speaker (この店, この辺, この部分).

examples.text: この本は人気があります。

meanings.note: Read ひと when standing as an independent noun.

examples.text: 親切な人に会いました。

meanings.note: In もういい, means 'already enough' or 'ready now'.
Read なん before だ/です/の, and なに before が/を or alone.

examples.text: 何を買いにきましたか。
examples.trans: What did you come to buy?

meanings.en: casual reflection or firm reminder particle
meanings.note: Used aloud to oneself ('man, I'm hungry') or at the end of a warning ('remember that, okay?').

meanings.en: in the end; after all; ultimately
meanings.note: Used when summing up what a situation comes down to.

examples.text: 結局、金がないと自由にもなれないんだな。
examples.trans: In the end, without money, you can't even be free.

examples.text: 結局、彼には会えませんでした。
examples.trans: In the end, I couldn't meet him.

examples.text: 結局本質を突きつけられたらな、プロじゃないヤツはみんな逃げていくんだよ。
examples.trans: In the end, once confronted with the real thing, everyone who isn't a pro runs away!

meanings.en: short casual form of じゃあ / では
meanings.note: Brisk spoken transition before taking the next step.
Negates verbs or forms じゃない ('is not') in questions like いいんじゃないか.

meanings.en: go forward; work out well (いけます = 'it will work!')
meanings.note: Written in kana for figurative headway: いけます! ('this can go / this will work!'), 思いどおりにいかない ('does not go as hoped').

examples.text: この企画ならいけます！
examples.trans: With this plan, it will work!

examples.text: 仕事がうまくいっています。

meanings.note: Always pairs with a negative verb; するしかありません means 'have no choice but to do'.

examples.trans: I only have one thousand yen.

meanings.note: Everyday noun for one's job or workplace duties.

examples.text: 新しい仕事は楽しいです。
これから仕事に行きます。
examples.trans: I am heading to work now.

examples.trans: I woke up early in the morning.

meanings.note: Contracts では; launches a decision ('well then') or opens casual farewell じゃあね.
Checks agreement ('isn't it?') or softens a request or farewell.
